links.comparator_used: Generic direct prompting without the calculator specification, relying on the model's built-in knowledge (closed-book)
links.outcome: Accuracy on MedCalc-Bench clinical calculator tasks
links.effect: Accuracy rose from ~52% to 81-85% on GLM-4.6V and GLM-4.7, surpassing all published results including RL-trained systems, without fine-tuning
links.quote: Second, we show that a simple intervention-providing the model with the calculator specification at inference time ("open-book" prompting)-raises accuracy from ~52% to 81-85% on GLM-4.6V and GLM-4.7, surpassing all published results including RL-trained systems, without any fine-tuning.

design_hint: open-book prompting with calculator specification (retrieval grounding)
